rules.statement: The requirement of an appeal deposit under Rule 49 (XII) (a) may be ultra vires and discourages or prevents bona fide appeals due to financial constraints.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the above reasons, I am of the view that a serious question arises as to the vires of Rule 49 (XII) (a)."

meta.parties: Sebastian Fernando v. Katana Multi Purpose Co Operative Society Ltd., and Others
